description: This file defines the ExtensionManager class responsible for managing and compiling extension files within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for handling authentication, initializing module data, merging module and application extension files, and saving the compiled extensions.
external_files: PHP functions: get_module_dir_list, dir, file_get_contents, is_dir, is_file, strlen, substr_count, unlink, mkdir_recursive, fopen, fwrite, fclose

classes.name: ExtensionManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing and compiling extension files for modules and applications in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: handleAuth
methods.description: Checks if the script is accessed from a valid entry point, terminates if not.

methods.name: initialise
methods.description: Initializes module list and logger instances.

methods.name: compileExtensionFiles
methods.description: Main method to compile extension files for a specific extension, targeting a file, with optional filtering and application-only flag.

methods.name: compileApplicationExtensions
methods.description: Merges application extension files into a target file.

methods.name: compileModuleExtensions
methods.description: Merges module-specific extension files into a target file.

methods.name: removePhpTagsFromString
methods.description: Removes PHP opening and closing tags from a string.

methods.name: shouldSkipFile
methods.description: Determines whether a given file should be skipped based on its name, type, and filter.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves extension content to a specified file, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: unlinkFile
methods.description: Deletes the specified extension file if it exists.
